text.traditional: （美心跟良介在學校）
text.simplified: （美心跟良介在学校）
text.pinyin: (Měixīn gēn Liángjiè zài xuéxiào)
text.english: (Meixin and Ryosuke are at school.)

text.traditional: 你怎麼了？為什麼不去吃午飯？
text.simplified: 你怎么了？为什么不去吃午饭？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zěnmele? Wèishénme bú qù chī wǔfàn?
text.english: What's wrong with you? Why don't you go for lunch?

text.traditional: 今天早上起來的時候，覺得背很疼，我想休息一下。
text.simplified: 今天早上起来的时候，觉得背很疼，我想休息一下。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshàng qǐlái de shíhòu, juéde bèi hěn téng, wǒ xiǎng xiūxí yíxià.
text.english: When I woke up this morning, I felt my back hurt very much. I think I need to take some rest.

text.traditional: 要是明天還是很疼，最好去看醫生或是去藥房買藥。
text.simplified: 要是明天还是很疼，最好去看医生或是去药房买药。
text.pinyin: Yàoshì míngtiān háishì hěn téng, zuìhǎo qù kàn yīshēng huòshì qù yàofáng mǎi yào.
text.english: If your back still hurts tomorrow, you'd better go to the doctor or buy some medicine in a pharmacy.

text.traditional: 謝謝妳。對了！我最近在網路上認識了一個女生，她不但很溫柔，也很客氣。我每天都給她打電話，我們聊得很愉快。
text.simplified: 谢谢你。对了！我最近在网路上认识了一个女生，她不但很温柔，也很客气。我每天都给她打电话，我们聊得很愉快。
text.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ. Duìle! Wǒ zuìjìn zài wǎnglù shàng rènshì le yíge nǚshēng, tā búdàn hěn wēnróu, yě hěn kèqì. Wǒ měi tiān dōu gěi tā dǎ diànhuà, wǒmen liáo de hěn yúkuài.
text.english: Thank you. By the way, I met a girl online lately. She's not only gentle but also polite. I call her every day and we chat happily.

text.traditional: 你們認識多久了？
text.simplified: 你们认识多久了？
text.pinyin: Nǐmen rènshì duōjiǔ le?
text.english: How long have you known each other?

text.traditional: 差不多一個月了。
text.simplified: 差不多一个月了。
text.pinyin: Chàbùduō yíge yuè le.
text.english: For around one month.

text.traditional: 見過面了嗎？
text.simplified: 见过面了吗？
text.pinyin: Jiàn guò miàn le ma?
text.english: Have you ever met?

text.traditional: 還沒，她說她不好意思跟我見面，所以我不知道怎麼辦。
text.simplified: 还没，她说她不好意思跟我见面，所以我不知道怎么办。
text.pinyin: Háiméi, tā shuō tā bùhǎoyìsi gēn wǒ jiànmiàn, suǒyǐ wǒ bù zhīdào zěnmebàn.
text.english: Not yet. She said she feels embarrassed to meet me, so I have no idea what to do.

text.traditional: 也許她覺得一個人跟你見面不安全。這個禮拜六學校有舞會，你要不要請她跟她朋友一起來參加？
text.simplified: 也许她觉得一个人跟你见面不安全。这个礼拜六学校有舞会，你要不要请她跟她朋友一起来参加？
text.pinyin: Yěxǔ tā juéde yígerén gēn nǐ jiànmiàn bù ānquán. Zhège lǐbàiliù xuéxiào yǒu wǔhuì, nǐ yào búyào qǐng tā gēn tā péngyǒu yìqǐ lái cānjiā?
text.english: Perhaps she doesn't feel safe to meet you alone. There's going to be a dance party in the school this Saturday. Will you invite her and her friends?

text.traditional: 這個辦法不錯，妳以前也有這樣的經驗嗎？
text.simplified: 这个办法不错，你以前也有这样的经验吗？
text.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ búcuò, nǐ yǐqián yě yǒu zhèyàng de jīngyàn ma?
text.english: This is not a bad idea. Did you have such an experience before?

text.traditional: 當然有啊！以前有一個男生要跟我約會，我也很害怕，不敢自己跟他見面。
text.simplified: 当然有啊！以前有一个男生要跟我约会，我也很害怕，不敢自己跟他见面。
text.pinyin: Dāngrán yǒu a! Yǐqián yǒu yíge nánshēng yào gēn wǒ yuēhuì, wǒ yě hěn hàipà, bù gǎn zìjǐ gēn tā jiànmiàn.
text.english: Of course I did! There was a boy who wanted to have a date with me. I was afraid and dared not meet him by myself.

text.traditional: 後來呢？
text.simplified: 后来呢？
text.pinyin: Hòulái ne?
text.english: And then?

text.traditional: 那個時候我剛好要跟同學去動物園玩，我就約他一起去。那天大家在動物園裡看看動物、開開玩笑，後來我就敢一個人跟他約會了。
text.simplified: 那个时候我刚好要跟同学去动物园玩，我就约他一起去。那天大家在动物园里看看动物、开开玩笑，后来我就敢一个人跟他约会了。
text.pinyin: Nàge shíhòu wǒ gānghǎo yào gēn tóngxué qù dòngwùyuán wán, wǒ jiù yuē tā yìqǐ qù. Nà tiān dàjiā zài dòngwùyuán lǐ kànkan dòngwù, kāi kāiwánxiào, hòulái wǒ jiù gǎn yígerén gēn tā yuēhuì le.
text.english: At that time I just wanted to go to the zoo with my classmates, so I asked him to go together with us. On that day, we saw the animals and made jokes at the zoo. From then on, I dared have a date with him alone.

text.traditional: 聽妳說完了以後，我想我知道應該怎麼做了。
text.simplified: 听你说完了以后，我想我知道应该怎么做了。
text.pinyin: Tīng nǐ shuō wán le yǐhòu, wǒ xiǎng wǒ zhīdào yīnggāi zěnme zuò le.
text.english: After listening to what you said, I think I know what to do.

text.traditional: 現在你的背好一點兒了嗎？
text.simplified: 现在你的背好一点儿了吗？
text.pinyin: Xiànzài nǐ de bèi hǎo yìdiǎnr le ma?
text.english: Is your back a bit better now?

text.traditional: （摸摸自己的背）好像不疼了。
text.simplified: （摸摸自己的背）好像不疼了。
text.pinyin: (Mō mō zìjǐ de bèi) hǎoxiàng bù téng le.
text.english: (Touches his own back.) It seems okay now.

text.traditional: （兩人都笑了）
text.simplified: （两人都笑了）
text.pinyin: (Liǎng rén dōu xiào le)
text.english: (Both of them laugh.)

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Verb + 一下: a quick action
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Ask someone to do something briefly, or make an action feel small and easy.
grammarPages.explanation: This grammar indicates the action of the verb lasts for a short time or the amount of action is quite small.

text.traditional: 他去一下洗手間，馬上回來。
text.simplified: 他去一下洗手间，马上回来。
text.pinyin: Tā qù yíxià xǐshǒujiān, mǎshàng huílái.
text.english: He stepped into the restroom for a moment and will be right back.

text.traditional: 你能介紹一下你自己嗎？
text.simplified: 你能介绍一下你自己吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ néng jièshào yíxià nǐ zìjǐ ma?
text.english: Could you introduce yourself a little?

text.traditional: 我去旁邊的商店買麵包，你可以等一下嗎？
text.simplified: 我去旁边的商店买面包，你可以等一下吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒ qù pángbiān de shāngdiàn mǎi miànbāo, nǐ kěyǐ děng yíxià ma?
text.english: I am going to the shop next door for bread; could you wait a moment?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This grammar indicates the action of the verb lasts for a short time or the amount of action is quite small.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This grammar indicates the action of the verb lasts for a short time or the amount of action is quite small.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give warm, practical advice about what someone should do.
grammarPages.explanation: This expression, often followed by a verb phrase, is used to give advice about what someone should do.

text.traditional: 你最好去看醫生，聽聽醫生怎麼說。
text.simplified: 你最好去看医生，听听医生怎么说。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo qù kàn yīshēng, tīng tīng yīshēng zěnme shuō.
text.english: You had better see a doctor and hear what they say.

text.traditional: 我們最好每天下了課就去圖書館念書。
text.simplified: 我们最好每天下了课就去图书馆念书。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen zuìhǎo měi tiān xià le kè jiù qù túshūguǎn niànshū.
text.english: We had better go to the library to study every day after class.

text.traditional: 你最好不要一個人去。
text.simplified: 你最好不要一个人去。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo búyào yígerén qù.
text.english: You had better not go alone.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This expression, often followed by a verb phrase, is used to give advice about what someone should do.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This expression, often followed by a verb phrase, is used to give advice about what someone should do.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a second true point with 也 instead of stopping after the first.
grammarPages.explanation: The “不但……，也……” pattern connects two phrases or clauses and indicates the two situations exist at the same time. If “不但” and “也” have the same topic, “不但” should come after the topic, connect with a phrase, and “也” connects with another phrase. If related to different aspects, “也” should come after the second aspect.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不但 + Clause 1 + 也 + Clause 2

text.traditional: 我不但想吃小籠包，也想吃牛肉麵。
text.simplified: 我不但想吃小笼包，也想吃牛肉面。
text.pinyin: Wǒ búdàn xiǎng chī xiǎolóngbāo, yě xiǎng chī niúròu miàn.
text.english: I not only want xiaolongbao, but also want beef noodles.

text.traditional: 學中文不但很有意思，也比較容易找工作。
text.simplified: 学中文不但很有意思，也比较容易找工作。
text.pinyin: Xué Zhōngwén búdàn hěn yǒuyìsi, yě bǐjiào róngyì zhǎo gōngzuò.
text.english: Learning Chinese is not only interesting; it also makes finding a job easier.

text.traditional: 因為台灣不但風景美，交通也很方便。
text.simplified: 因为台湾不但风景美，交通也很方便。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi Táiwān búdàn fēngjǐng měi, jiāotōng yě hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: Because Taiwan not only has beautiful scenery, but its transport is also convenient.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The “不但……，也……” pattern connects two phrases or clauses and indicates the two situations exist at the same time. If “不但” and “也” have the same topic, “不但” should come after the topic, connect with a phrase, and “也” connects with another phrase. If related to different aspects, “也” should come after the second aspect.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The “不但……，也……” pattern connects two phrases or clauses and indicates the two situations exist at the same time. If “不但” and “也” have the same topic, “不但” should come after the topic, connect with a phrase, and “也” connects with another phrase. If related to different aspects, “也” should come after the second aspect.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say an action is completely finished, and ask whether it is done yet.
grammarPages.explanation: The expression indicates that an action is finished. The “完”, serving as a verb complement, means “done” or “finished”.

text.traditional: 今天的作業不多，我很快就寫完了。
text.simplified: 今天的作业不多，我很快就写完了。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān de zuòyè bù duō, wǒ hěn kuài jiù xiě wán le.
text.english: There is not much homework today; I finished writing it quickly.

text.traditional: 聽說上個星期就賣完了。
text.simplified: 听说上个星期就卖完了。
text.pinyin: Tīngshuō shàng ge xīngqí jiù mài wán le.
text.english: I heard they sold out last week.

text.traditional: 這個禮拜我很忙，還沒看完。
text.simplified: 这个礼拜我很忙，还没看完。
text.pinyin: Zhège lǐbài wǒ hěn máng, háiméi kàn wán.
text.english: I have been busy this week, so I have not finished reading it yet.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The expression indicates that an action is finished. The “完”, serving as a verb complement, means “done” or “finished”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The expression indicates that an action is finished. The “完”, serving as a verb complement, means “done” or “finished”.

BOOK2_LESSON_ONE_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 5–9 · The First Time They Met

text.traditional: 山本良介本來是一個害羞的日本學生，來台灣以後，他住在學校的宿舍，認識了很多朋友，常常跟他們去吃飯、打球。放假的時候，朋友帶他去參觀博物館、看表演，所以他覺得在台灣的生活很快樂，也好像不那麼害羞了。
text.simplified: 山本良介本来是一个害羞的日本学生，来台湾以后，他住在学校的宿舍，认识了很多朋友，常常跟他们去吃饭、打球。放假的时候，朋友带他去参观博物馆、看表演，所以他觉得在台湾的生活很快乐，也好像不那么害羞了。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè běnlái shì yíge hàixiū de Rìběn xuéshēng, lái Táiwān yǐhòu, tā zhù zài xuéxiào de sùshè, rènshì le hěn duō péngyǒu, chángcháng gēn tāmen qù chīfàn, dǎqiú. Fàngjià de shíhòu, péngyǒu dài tā qù cānguān bówùguǎn, kàn biǎoyǎn, suǒyǐ tā juéde zài Táiwān de shēnghuó hěn kuàilè, yě hǎoxiàng bú nàme hàixiū le.
text.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke was originally a shy Japanese student. After coming to Taiwan, he lives in the school dorm and met many friends. Ryosuke often eats out and plays balls with them. On holidays, his friends take him to visit the museum and watch the show, so he feels very happy living in Taiwan and he doesn't seem to be as shy as before.

text.traditional: 有一天，他在網路上認識了一個女生，她是台灣的大學生。因為她覺得跟不熟的男生約會很危險，所以一直不敢跟良介見面。後來良介寄給她一張卡片，請她跟她的朋友來學校參加舞會。不久，他們就在學校見面了。他們見面的時候，良介的心跳得很快。
text.simplified: 有一天，他在网路上认识了一个女生，她是台湾的大学生。因为她觉得跟不熟的男生约会很危险，所以一直不敢跟良介见面。后来良介寄给她一张卡片，请她跟她的朋友来学校参加舞会。不久，他们就在学校见面了。他们见面的时候，良介的心跳得很快。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān, tā zài wǎnglù shàng rènshì le yíge nǚshēng, tā shì Táiwān de dàxuéshēng. Yīnwèi tā juéde gēn bù shóu de nánshēng yuēhuì hěn wéixiǎn, suǒyǐ yìzhí bù gǎn gēn Liángjiè jiànmiàn. Hòulái Liángjiè jì gěi tā yì zhāng kǎpiàn, qǐng tā gēn tā de péngyǒu lái xuéxiào cānjiā wǔhuì. Bùjiǔ, tāmen jiù zài xuéxiào jiànmiàn le. Tāmen jiànmiàn de shíhòu, Liángjiè de xīntiào de hěn kuài.
text.english: One day, he met a girl on the Internet. She is a Taiwanese university student. She thought dating a guy she was not familiar with in person was dangerous, so she had never dared to date Ryosuke. Later on, Ryosuke sent her a card and invited her and her friends to the school to attend a dance party. Soon after, they met at the school. When they met each other, Ryosuke's heart beat so fast.

text.traditional: 那天，他們一邊跳舞，一邊聊天，兩個人都很開心。良介覺得那個女生不但很漂亮，個性也很好，很想趕快再跟她約會。舞會結束以後，他們在學校裡散步，良介不好意思拉她的手，只跟她說，能認識她真的很幸運，希望以後有機會再跟她見面。
text.simplified: 那天，他们一边跳舞，一边聊天，两个人都很开心。良介觉得那个女生不但很漂亮，个性也很好，很想赶快再跟她约会。舞会结束以后，他们在学校里散步，良介不好意思拉她的手，只跟她说，能认识她真的很幸运，希望以后有机会再跟她见面。
text.pinyin: Nà tiān, tāmen yìbiān tiàowǔ, yìbiān liáotiān, liǎng ge rén dōu hěn kāixīn. Liángjiè juéde nàge nǚshēng búdàn hěn piàoliàng, gèxìng yě hěn hǎo, hěn xiǎng gǎnkuài zài gēn tā yuēhuì. Wǔhuì jiéshù yǐhòu, tāmen zài xuéxiào lǐ sànbù, Liángjiè bùhǎoyìsi lā tā de shǒu, zhǐ gēn tā shuō, néng rènshì tā zhēnde hěn xìngyùn, xīwàng yǐhòu yǒu jīhuì zài gēn tā jiànmiàn.
text.english: On that day, they chatted as they danced. Both of them were having a good time. Ryosuke thought the girl was not only beautiful but also with a great personality, so he wanted to have a date with her soon. After the dance party had ended, they took a walk in the school. Ryosuke was embarrassed and dared not hold her hand, but simply said to her that he was really lucky to meet her, and looking forward to seeing her again.

text.traditional: 那個女生覺得雖然良介是外國人，中文也說得不太好，可是他們的興趣一樣，都喜歡看書、運動，而且跟他在一起很安全、很有意思。現在他們不但常常上網聊天，也會一起去打籃球、騎腳踏車呢！
text.simplified: 那个女生觉得虽然良介是外国人，中文也说得不太好，可是他们的兴趣一样，都喜欢看书、运动，而且跟他在一起很安全、很有意思。现在他们不但常常上网聊天，也会一起去打篮球、骑脚踏车呢！
text.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng juéde suīrán Liángjiè shì wàiguórén, Zhōngwén yě shuō de bú tài hǎo, kěshì tāmen de xìngqù yíyàng, dōu xǐhuān kàn shū, yùndòng, érqiě gēn tā zài yìqǐ hěn ānquán, hěn yǒuyìsi. Xiànzài tāmen búdàn chángcháng shàngwǎng liáotiān, yě huì yìqǐ qù dǎ lánqiú, qí jiǎotàchē ne!
text.english: The girl thinks that although Ryosuke is a foreigner and doesn't speak good Chinese, their interests are the same. They both like to read and exercise. Moreover, she feels secure and fun being with him. Now, they not only chat online often, but also play basketball and ride bicycles together!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say where someone or something sits, stands, lives, or is placed.
grammarPages.explanation: The structure of the pattern is “V在+Location”. The verbs often placed before “在” include “住 (live)”, “坐 (sit)” and “站 (stand)”.

text.traditional: 爸爸忘了他的手機放在哪裡了。
text.simplified: 爸爸忘了他的手机放在哪里了。
text.pinyin: Bàba wàngle tā de shǒujī fàng zài nǎlǐ le.
text.english: Dad forgot where he put his phone.

text.traditional: 你不要站在那麼高的地方，很危險！
text.simplified: 你不要站在那么高的地方，很危险！
text.pinyin: Nǐ búyào zhàn zài nàme gāo de dìfāng, hěn wéixiǎn!
text.english: Don't stand in such a high place—it is dangerous!

text.traditional: 我住在捷運站附近，走路五分鐘就到了。
text.simplified: 我住在捷运站附近，走路五分钟就到了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài jiéyùn zhàn fùjìn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
text.english: I live near the MRT station; it is a five-minute walk.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The structure of the pattern is “V在+Location”. The verbs often placed before “在” include “住 (live)”, “坐 (sit)” and “站 (stand)”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The structure of the pattern is “V在+Location”. The verbs often placed before “在” include “住 (live)”, “坐 (sit)” and “站 (stand)”.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Mark who receives a thing or a message after verbs like 送、賣、寄、拿.
grammarPages.explanation: “給” functions as a preposition that comes after a verb, shows the direction, and marks the recipient of an action.

text.traditional: 那些書，我送給朋友了。
text.simplified: 那些书，我送给朋友了。
text.pinyin: Nàxiē shū, wǒ sòng gěi péngyǒu le.
text.english: I gave those books to a friend.

text.traditional: 王先生的舊車賣給張小姐了。
text.simplified: 王先生的旧车卖给张小姐了。
text.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng de jiù chē mài gěi Zhāng xiǎojiě le.
text.english: Mr. Wang sold his old car to Miss Zhang.

text.traditional: 我拿著電話，可是忘了要打給誰了。
text.simplified: 我拿着电话，可是忘了要打给谁了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ ná zhe diànhuà, kěshì wàngle yào dǎ gěi shéi le.
text.english: I was holding the phone but forgot whom I meant to call.

text.traditional: 桌上的水果，你拿給誰吃了？
text.simplified: 桌上的水果，你拿给谁吃了？
text.pinyin: Zhuō shàng de shuǐguǒ, nǐ ná gěi shéi chī le?
text.english: Who did you give the fruit on the table to?

text.traditional: 我沒聽過十二生肖的故事，你可以說給我聽嗎？
text.simplified: 我没听过十二生肖的故事，你可以说给我听吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒ méi tīng guò shí'èr shēngxiào de gùshì, nǐ kěyǐ shuō gěi wǒ tīng ma?
text.english: I have never heard the story of the twelve zodiac animals. Could you tell it to me?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “給” functions as a preposition that comes after a verb, shows the direction, and marks the recipient of an action.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “給” functions as a preposition that comes after a verb, shows the direction, and marks the recipient of an action.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe two actions happening at the same time, with one or two subjects.
grammarPages.explanation: The “（一）邊……（，）（一）邊……” pattern implies that the two actions coming after each “一邊” happen at the same time or at the same place. This pattern is mostly used in modifying concrete action verbs and it can be used in sentences with only one subject or in complex sentences with two subjects, eg. “他一邊唱，我一邊跳。”. If “一” is omitted, there should be only one subject in the sentence, eg. “他邊唱邊跳。”.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一邊 + Action 1 + 一邊 + Action 2

text.traditional: 有人一邊走路一邊玩手機，真危險。
text.simplified: 有人一边走路一边玩手机，真危险。
text.pinyin: Yǒu rén yì biān zǒulù yì biān wán shǒujī, zhēn wéixiǎn.
text.english: Some people walk and use their phones at the same time; that is really dangerous.

text.traditional: 很多學生喜歡一邊聽音樂，一邊念書。
text.simplified: 很多学生喜欢一边听音乐，一边念书。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō xuéshēng xǐhuān yì biān tīng yīnyuè, yì biān niànshū.
text.english: Many students like to listen to music while studying.

text.traditional: 上課的時候，老師一邊說，學生一邊寫。
text.simplified: 上课的时候，老师一边说，学生一边写。
text.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhòu, lǎoshī yì biān shuō, xuéshēng yì biān xiě.
text.english: In class, the teacher talks while the students write.

This pattern is mostly used in modifying concrete action verbs and it can be used in sentences with only one subject or in complex sentences with two subjects, eg. “他一邊唱，我一邊跳。”. If “一” is omitted, there should be only one subject in the sentence, eg. “他邊唱邊跳。”.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Admit one fact, then give the surprising or contrasting result.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern implies that the speaker agrees to the information coming after “雖然” but the information coming after “可是” is unexpected.
grammarPages.pattern: 雖然 + Clause 1 + 可是 + Clause 2

text.traditional: 雖然不容易，可是我覺得很有意思。
text.simplified: 虽然不容易，可是我觉得很有意思。
text.pinyin: Suīrán bù róngyì, kěshì wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
text.english: Although it is not easy, I find it very interesting.

text.traditional: 雖然他很聰明，可是不喜歡讀書，所以考得不好。
text.simplified: 虽然他很聪明，可是不喜欢读书，所以考得不好。
text.pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngmíng, kěshì bù xǐhuān dúshū, suǒyǐ kǎo de bùhǎo.
text.english: Although he is clever, he does not like studying, so he did not do well on the test.

text.traditional: 雖然不舒服，可是今天公司有很重要的事，一定要去。
text.simplified: 虽然不舒服，可是今天公司有很重要的事，一定要去。
text.pinyin: Suīrán bù shūfu, kěshì jīntiān gōngsī yǒu hěn zhòngyào de shì, yídìng yào qù.
text.english: Although I feel unwell, something very important is happening at the company today, so I must go.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern implies that the speaker agrees to the information coming after “雖然” but the information coming after “可是” is unexpected.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern implies that the speaker agrees to the information coming after “雖然” but the information coming after “可是” is unexpected.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize a fact politely, as if saying 'you know' or 'actually'.
grammarPages.explanation: This particle “呢”, often placed at the end of a sentence, is used to emphasize that the foregoing action or fact is based on the speaker’s personal opinion. It shows a tone of politeness. The “呢” used here is different from that used in an interrogative sentence.

text.traditional: 不，他家離我家很近呢！
text.simplified: 不，他家离我家很近呢！
text.pinyin: Bù, tā jiā lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn ne!
text.english: No—his home is actually very close to mine!

text.traditional: 可是我覺得很好看，想再看一次呢！
text.simplified: 可是我觉得很好看，想再看一次呢！
text.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde hěn hǎokàn, xiǎng zài kàn yí cì ne!
text.english: But I think it is really good—I actually want to see it again!

text.traditional: 他沒出去玩，他一直在房間讀書呢！
text.simplified: 他没出去玩，他一直在房间读书呢！
text.pinyin: Tā méi chūqù wán, tā yìzhí zài fángjiān dúshū ne!
text.english: He did not go out to play—he has been studying in his room!
